## Purpose

`SavingsSource` is the closed taxonomy of "which Mustard intervention produced this saving", and every savings record, breakdown row and dashboard column keys off it. It derives `#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash, Serialize, Deserialize)]` with `#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]` and `#[non_exhaustive]`, so it can be a `HashMap` key in the reader's roll-up and can grow without breaking downstream matches. It owns TWO string mappings on purpose: `as_str()` returns the snake_case word used as the payload's `source` field and the dashboard grouping key, while `writer.rs`'s private `savings_suffix()` returns the kebab-case word used in the event name `pipeline.economy.savings.{suffix}` — the comment above it says explicitly that the two are distinct. `from_str_opt` is the exact inverse of `as_str` and returns `None` for an unknown string so a reader drops an unrecognised row rather than mistyping it; there is no `Unknown` variant and no `Default`. Each variant's doc comment states what was saved and how the token count was estimated.

## Convention

`packages/core/src/domain/economy/` — the enum is declared in `model.rs` beside the record that carries it (`SavingsRecord::source`, `SavingsBySource::source`) and re-exported from `economy/mod.rs`; the event-name mapping stays private inside `writer.rs`; per-source ingestion adapters live under `economy/sources/` (`rtk.rs`, `otel.rs`) and build `SavingsRecord`s tagged with their variant. `writer.rs` builders are pure `(event_name, payload)` constructors — no IO, no `Result` — because `mustard-core` never writes the NDJSON itself.

## How to apply

A new intervention adds ONE variant plus arms in all THREE exhaustive matches — `as_str`, `from_str_opt`, and `savings_suffix` — and the compiler will point at each one; keep the snake_case payload word and the kebab-case event suffix in sync but distinct. Document in the variant what baseline the token count is measured against. Extend `savings_source_roundtrip_string` in `model.rs` with the new variant and the event-name table test in `writer.rs`, then add the producing adapter under `economy/sources/` if the saving is ingested from an external channel. Never add a `Default` or a catch-all variant: unrecognised input is `None` at the parse boundary, and the reader skips the row.
